description: Behavioral regression cases for the documented workflow and scope boundaries.

evals.name: equal-exclusive-range
evals.prompt: Optimize db.items.find({x:{$gte:5,$lt:5}}). x is a scalar number; no connection is available.
evals.expected_output: Preserve the empty interval, report the inconsistency, and do not rewrite it to equality or invent measured gains.

assertions.name: empty preserved
assertions.check: Does not replace the exclusive equal-bound predicate with x:5 or $eq:5.

assertions.name: honest evidence
assertions.check: Reports no live explain measurement and marks impact UNVERIFIED.

evals.name: regex-collation
evals.prompt: My query is db.users.find({name:/^ann/i}). Would a strength-2 collation index make this regex efficient?
evals.expected_output: Explain regex is not collation-aware, keep match semantics and recommend checking evidence-backed alternatives without creating an index.

assertions.name: regex rule
assertions.check: States that case-insensitive collation indexes do not accelerate $regex.

assertions.name: semantics
assertions.check: Does not silently make the expression case-sensitive or change prefix search to equality.

assertions.name: index guard
assertions.check: Recommends rather than creates an index.

evals.name: read-only-index-guard
evals.prompt: Run /dmqo pipeline.json --read-only --apply-index --report --annotate. The pipeline has $match and $merge.
evals.expected_output: Emit proposed read-stage changes only; do not build indexes, write files or execute $merge.

assertions.name: no mutations
assertions.check: Creates no index, report, annotation or source file.

assertions.name: no merge execution
assertions.check: Does not execute the writing pipeline for verification.

evals.name: duplicate-outputs
evals.prompt: A $lookup/$unwind rewrite returns the same nReturned as before, but one document is duplicated and another is missing. Is that equivalent?
evals.expected_output: Reject equivalence, retain multiplicity/document comparison and back out the change.

assertions.name: not count-only
assertions.check: Rejects equal nReturned as sufficient equivalence evidence.

assertions.name: rollback
assertions.check: Requires backing out the result-changing rewrite.
